review_description: Tom from Apollo was very knowledgeable and always available to answer the numerous questions I had in regards to quality and warranty of the panels and the inverter, he didn’t try to push us into buying a battery informing us we should be able to generate enough power to accomodate our energy needs with a little to no power bill. He also advised us that the government will be offering assistance in purchasing a battery towards the end of 2024 or early in 2025. No deposit up front and once agreement signed installation was very quick and efficient. I would have liked a little more after sales assistance to find the best energy supplier to go with and help understanding the app. But I’m very happy so far.

The whole process from start to finish was simple.  The quotes received were easy to understand and made final selection very simple.14kw solar with 2x5kw fronius inverters and 11kw batteries, all installed and running in 3 days. With all required connections in place.

After 8 months of research, 6 different quotes, delays due to flooding and insurance. Mark was so easy to talk to work with through it all. The Apollo install team where fantasic and a great group who my dog loved so that says it all. The office team were also fantastic, friendly and easy to work with.The quality of the install was very well executed and when i requested to make slight changes it was not too hard or a problem.
Great efficient on all aspects from Enquiry to completion, even logged in a few days later to modify inverter position as one was not reading the correct generation given its aspect on the roof.
Best all round compared to others in the area, great job done by Nick and his offsider. Thanks Nick
